title: ClearPath Managed IT Services Schedule D: Coverage Hours and Holiday Calendar
content:
Coverage hours for ClearPath Managed IT Services are the days of the week and the daily window, US Eastern, inside which the tier's service desk coverage runs; observed company holidays fall outside coverage hours where the tier excludes them.

## D.1 Coverage window by tier

| Tier | Coverage days | Coverage start | Coverage end | Observed holidays outside coverage | Remote work outside business hours included | Remote P1 work outside coverage included |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ClearPath Monitor | Mon-Fri | 08:00 | 17:00 | Yes | No | No |
| ClearPath Essentials | Mon-Fri | 08:00 | 18:00 | Yes | No | No |
| ClearPath Standard | Mon-Fri | 07:00 | 19:00 | Yes | No | No |
| ClearPath Professional | Mon-Fri | 07:00 | 19:00 | Yes | No | Yes |
| ClearPath Premier | Mon-Sun | 00:00 | 24:00 | No | Yes | Yes |
| ClearPath Enterprise | Mon-Sun | 00:00 | 24:00 | No | Yes | Yes |

A coverage end of 24:00 means midnight. "Remote work outside business hours included" states whether covered remote work outside business hours is included in the seat fee. "Remote P1 work outside coverage included" states whether remote work on a P1 ticket outside coverage hours is included even when after-hours remote work is not.

## D.2 Observed holiday list

Every tier carries the same list of company holidays observed by the service desk and excluded from business days: New Year's Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day and Christmas Day. On ClearPath Monitor, ClearPath Essentials, ClearPath Standard and ClearPath Professional these holidays also fall outside coverage hours; on ClearPath Premier and ClearPath Enterprise coverage continues through them.

## D.3 Illustrations (hypothetical moments)

- A Tuesday at 18:30 is inside coverage on ClearPath Standard (07:00 to 19:00) and outside it on ClearPath Essentials (08:00 to 18:00).
- A Saturday at 10:00 is outside coverage on the four Mon-Fri tiers and inside it on ClearPath Premier and ClearPath Enterprise.
- Thanksgiving Day at 11:00 is outside coverage on ClearPath Professional and inside it on ClearPath Premier.
